product.ta-1900-base.summary: This version brought the TA 1900 to decentralised installations in an entry-level floppy configuration.
product.ta-1900-base.history: Triumph-Adler presented it in Hanover in 1983 for data collection, information retrieval and standalone project work.
product.ta-1900-base.technical.configura: A data link allowed integration into existing networks. The announced configuration included a screen, printer, 128 KB of memory and two 1 MB drives.
product.ta-1900-base.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1900-base.technical.limitatio: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
